articleTitle: Application of genetic algorithms for the design of WEEE logistics network model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: The recovery of the Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment (WEEE) has been becoming a major problem due to its environment hazards and public health. Reverse logistics network is a powerful approach. How to minimize the total recycle cost is of great importance for enterprises to win the customers. In this paper, we formulate a mathematical model of remanufacturing system as two stage logistics network. Genetic algorithm (GA) was applied to get the optimal sit of collection centers, disassembly centers, returning centers and the optimal path of shipment. It is proposed with priority-based encoding method combined a position-based crossover by topological sort. The experiment results show that our proposed method is effective.

articleTitle: A new method of reliable evaluation on integrated circuit
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: Due to the increasing of complexity of the packing materials, processes and functions, it's difficult to quickly and accurately evaluate the reliability of integrated circuit. To solve this problem, a new method for fast evaluation of the reliability and life time of integrated circuits, which is based on ESPI (Electronic Speckle Pattern Interferometer) technology, is presented. This method predicts the specimen life time according to the change of out-of-plane displacement of integrated circuit packing under the condition of accelerated temperature stress. The activation energy of specimen can be extracted rapidly according to the law of speckle candy-stripe varying with specimen temperature, and the working life time of specimen at normal temperature can also be obtained. Experiment results meet the data in reference documents, which demonstrates the feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: The video water marking scheme based on MPEG-4 motion vector
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: The watermark embedding scheme is a improved algorithm of video watermarking. Basing on the Jordan motion vector watermarking algorithm and the human visual identification system and the secret key principle, we divide the motion vectors into two types. And according to the specific circumstances of motion vectors, we embed the watermark into the selected motion vectors, then the extraction process doesn't need the original video. The image of experiment proves that the algorithm has good invisibility and concealment.

articleTitle: Steganalysis of the MP3 steganographic algorithm based on Huffman coding
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: Huffman codes replacement algorithm is a new steganographic method by replacing Huffman codes to hide information. The advantages are simple computation, large capacity, good imperceptibility, and so on. However there is no steganalytic method can be used for the new algorithm. A statistical model of the Huffman codes replacement is presented by steganalysising a MP3 algorithm and a steganalysis scheme was proposed which was implemented by using support vector machine (SVM) to classify the stego audio from clear audio.

articleTitle: Intelligent geomagnetic matching method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: Geomagnetism aided navigation technique is a new branch of integrated navigation system. It is raised to reduce the dependence of navigation system on GPS. Our attention is focused on magnetic matching method. Based on PSO, an intelligent matching method is proposed. Contour constraint is used as prior information about the real path to confine particles initialization, so as to make sure that at least one particle is around the real path. Under this constraint, efficiency and precision of the method will be greatly improved. In simulation experiments, both matching results and integrated navigation results showed good performance.

articleTitle: Measurement of relative configuration and velocity of mobile robot based on monocular vision
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: This paper addresses a method to measure the relative configuration and velocity of a leading mobile robot with respect to the following robot using monocular vision. This method can obtain single solution in certain conditions and has high precision. Simulation results show it is feasible.

articleTitle: Distributed proactive defense based on cloud computing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: Traditional centralized proactive defense architecture is easy to be attacked, and high traffic, poor scalability, especially when the network scale is large, its efficiency has been greatly decreased. Distributed proactive defense architecture based on cloud computing is proposed, which combines the advantages of cloud computing and the concept of collaboration. The architecture was described in detail. Meanwhile, distributed intrusion detection on GEP-BP in cloud computing is implemented.

articleTitle: Health diagnosis for aircraft based on the ARMA model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: According to the AE (Acoustic Emission, AE) signal that caused by the aircraft structural crack, this paper proposed a health diagnosis approach based on ARMA model and SVM (Support Vector Machine, SVM). Firstly, this method apperceives the healthy information of a real aircraft stabilizer with real time by using AE detecting system. And then, deal with the information collected. Secondly, built an ARMA model and extracting parameter of ARMA model to set up characteristic vector. Finally, design and apply SVM monitor to diagnose the aircraft structure healthy state. Experiments show that the monitor has good performance to recognize and diagnose the fatigue crack of aircraft stabilizer, this approach is proposed to be effective. And it presents a new kind of approach to monitor the health state of aircraft structure and can also be used in other complex system structure health monitoring.

articleTitle: Study of equipment inspection system based on Zigbee
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: In recent years, security risks of equipment are very prominent. In order to ensure normal operations, equipment inspection is required to standardization. Information technology is an important means of ensuring the safe operation of equipment. In this paper, a new equipment inspection system based on Zigbee is presented. This system is composed of data management center, wireless gateway, wireless relay routers, hand-held terminals and RFID tags. The system has been used in metallurgical production. The result shows that this system can guarantee the smooth progress of inspection work to improve the level of operation management and the safety of equipment operation.

articleTitle: Penalty kick strategy using two-player collaboration method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: In order to improve the match success rate, we proposed a penalty kick strategy based on two-player collaborative shooting method which is used in two different defense patterns. In this strategy, a self-rotation shooting method is applied when the opponent goalkeeper run out to destroy the ball and a reflecting shooting method is used when the goalkeeper stays at the goal line. The SimuroSot 5vs5 Simulation experiments were conducted on the Robot Soccer v1.5a platform. Experimental results show that the proposed method can get a good match success rate.

articleTitle: Research based on XML/SOAP BACnet and internet integration technology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology, a variety of control functions in intelligent building is strengthening, BACnet is the most open and interoperability building automatic control network, which integrated with the Internet, have been an inevitable trend. This paper has provided a technology of BACnet integrate with Internet using XML and SOAP, which has a good characteristic of open, expandability and cross-platform, and also design and implement a kind of an intermediate device as a key to make the integrated scheme and the specific implementation.

articleTitle: An adaptive fragile audio watermarking based on MDFT
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: To modify DFT transform and make it belong to unitary transform, the conception of MDFT((Modified Discrete Fourier Transform) is proposed. At the same time, an adaptive digital audio blind detection fragile watermarking algorithm based on MDFT is proposed. Firstly, the original audio signal was divided into several audio frames, and then to choose the frames by using the pseudorandom number, to make MDFT. Secondly, the watermark bits were embedded into MDFT the N/2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> coefficients, the watermarking strong was adaptive to signal energy. The watermarking could be extracted without the original audio signal and the algorithm realized watermarking blind detection. The chaos and the pseudorandom number encryption techniques were used in the algorithm and it had got good security. Experimental results demonstrated the algorithm was fragile and imperceptible.

Author Keywords: Pseudorandom Number e algorithm is fragile and inaudibility

articleTitle: A RSA keys sharing scheme based on dynamic threshold secret sharing algorithm for WMNs
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: Wireless Mesh networks (WMNs) is a new wireless network with great potential application, its security is also affected by people's attention. Establishing a distributed virtual CA is an important tool to ensure the security of the wireless mesh networks. In these scenarios, several nodes jointly reserve the system's private key. This article proposes a RSA key sharing scheme based on dynamic threshold secret sharing algorithm. In this scheme, the child secrets that are saved by the shared nodes can be reused. When the shared nodes are changed, it is not necessary to repeat the procedures for distributing the child secrets.

articleTitle: Research of a personalized search engine based on user interest mining
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet technology, search engine has been widely used in many fields, which is treated as a tool that people can find information they need on World Wide Web. In order to provide personalized search service for users, personalized search engine comes forth. Analyzing the shortage of current search engine and user's requirements of personalized search, this paper designs a personalized search engine model that is based on user interest mining. Many experiments verify the proposed model is effective.

articleTitle: Special factor backtracking algorithm for optimizing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: The ant colony algorithm has slow convergence speed and very easily falls in local optimal solutions. Based on the Max-Min Ant System and the mutation ant colony algorithm, a special factor backtracking algorithm has been developed in this work and is used after ant colony algorithm for optimal solutions. The experiments show that 2 percentage can be achieved by a special factor backtracking algorithm.

articleTitle: A framework for developing dependable software systems using the SOFL formal engineering method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: Development of a dependable software requires a variety of techniques to be used in a coherent and systematic process, since it is required to take the reliability, safety, and security of the system into account. In this paper, we describe a framework for developing dependable software systems using the SOFL formal engineering method, and demonstrate its applicability by a case study developing and ATM system using the framework.

articleTitle: Translation-based verification of Web services composition via ZING
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: BPEL4WS (BPEL for short) is a standard business process execution language for Web services composition. To formally verify the correctness and reliability of Web services compositions, we propose an Input/Output Labelled Transition System (I/OLTS) as the intermediate formal model, which is well adapted to model BPEL constructs and handle faults, events, terminations, message correlation and activities. To be able to automatically verify Web services compositions via a model checker, we first develop a translation procedure to translate BPEL language into I/OLTS, and then develop another translation procedure to translate the I/OLTS model into the input language of ZING, a software model checker developed by Microsoft. The translation-based verification process for Web services composition is illustrated by a case study.

articleTitle: Research of comparison of intelligent extraction methods based on high spatial resolution image
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: With the application of Geographic entities for the expression of remote sensing information model, Analysis of remote sensing image was improved from pixels to the object layers. Combined with rules and reasoning mechanism, identification of geographical entities had been improved with intelligence from the image objects using more multiple factors. The traditional pixel-based methods that could not been effectively carried out information extraction on the high spatial resolution image was broken. A result of comparison was Provided about information extraction of remote sensing image in a mining area of Guangxi. The classification accuracy of two methods based on pixels and objects was evaluated. The difficulty of integration had been reduced between remote sensing information and GIS.

articleTitle: CAN bus communication system based on SOC technology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: The CAN bus communication system based on SOC technology is proposed. A design framework of CAN controller IP core is introduced, and a complete CAN bus communication system is realized in a ALTERA Cyclone III type FPGA chip, which has a set of 51 SCM IP core, memory IP core, CAN controller IP core and controller software. Finally, both software simulation and hardware tests verify the correctness of this CAN bus communication system.

articleTitle: Robust fuzzy PID controller for wind turbines
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: PID and fuzzy PID controller are used for the wind turbine with the nonlinear mathematical model. PID control has simple principle and its parameters setting are rather easy. Fuzzy PID controller combines with the reasoning goals/constraints on robustness (robust fuzzy PID controller), which can effectively improve the robustness. MATLAB software is used for simulations, and the results display that the robust fuzzy PID controller has better performances than the PID controller when errors exist, especially robustness performance.

articleTitle: A novel MPR approach based on inverse-traversing of Multi-Labeled Tree
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: A novel Multi-Path Routing (MPR) approach based on inverse-traversing of Multi-Labeled Tree (MLT) is proposed. MLT can be constructed through the probing process of multiple labeled messages. Then, multiple disjoint paths can be located by inverse-traversing of the MLT. Both the constructing of MLT and the locating of the paths are decentralized processes. Simulation experiments indicate that MLT based NDMPR can find more node-disjoint paths than CT approach with a little increment in routing table size at each node. In addition, the average path length using our approach is smaller than that of CT approach.

articleTitle: Adaptive neural network control for a class of nonlinear time-delay systems
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: An observer-based adaptive neural network robust control for a class of nonlinear time-delay systems with unmodeled dynamics. By the implicit function theorem, Taylor's formula and mean theorem, the form of the non-affine nonlinear systems is transformed into the form of affine nonlinear systems. The controller designed to attenuate the effect of external disturbance and approximation errors of the neural networks on tracking. The applicability of our results is demonstrated by means of a specific example.

articleTitle: An improved algorithm of rat sperm image segmentation and counting
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: Aiming at the poor real-time characteristics of traditional Ostu for rat sperm image segmentation, we improved this Ostu-based segmentation to reduce its computational time by using Newton iteration. This improved algorithm applies the shape factors to remove impurities and morphology to mark each sperm with digital tags. The experiments show that this method provides fast and accurate sperm image segmentation and automatic counting of the number of sperms in the images.

articleTitle: 2-D maximum entropy spermatozoa image segmentation based on Canny operator
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: Aiming at the problems of sperm microscopic imaging that is unclear, low-contrast and involves many impurities, a two-dimensional maximum entropy segmentation based on canny operator is presented. First, the initial sperm image segmentation is made according to its features. Next, the real spermatozoa edge is detected by using Canny operator. Finally, the 2-D maximum entropy segmentation is used for the segmentation of sperm image targets and their edges according to different thresholds, thus solving the imprecise segmentation problems because of the local blurred and overlapping spermatozoa image. The experiments show that this spermatozoa image segmentation is of good robustness and high segmentation accuracy.

articleTitle: Using datamining tools in analyzing undergraduate paper results in Computer Science at Óbuda University
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: Students may download the teaching material of Computer Science from a web based system after logging in a server saving username and the time of each file download. A statistical audit is based on this data. Analysing the data of the second semester made possible to draw conclusions regarding learning habits [1] and the correlation between the time of download and the result of the papers written by the students. As a first result of this analysis high download numbers were found at the time of lectures of different subjects. Many of the students do not visit the presentations of different subjects, which accounts for the bad paper results in this case. As a second result of this analysis the highest number of downloads was found one day before the test or on the test day. This means students are not interested in CS. The situation is similar when looking at other subjects. Students try hard to get a degree without learning.

articleTitle: A lifetime prognostics method for aviation generator based on grey theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: For the problem that aviation generator lifetime prognostics is difficult, this paper proposes a prognostics method for aviation generator lifetime based on grey theory. A real military aviation generator is tested to obtain a large number of lifetime data. After the analysis about the military aviation generator lifetime data, the paper uses grey theory to design two models of aviation generator lifetime prognostics, which are GM (1, 1) and MGM (1, n). The single and more parameters are respectively used to set grey models to prognosticate the aviation generator lifetime. Experiments show that the MGM (1, 3) established by speed, load and oil-filled pressure can prognosticate the aviation generator lifetime more accurately than the GM (1, 1). The prognostics average relative error of MGM (1, 3) is only 2.21%. It presents a new method to solve the problem of aviation generator lifetime prognostics. And this method has a good use foreground to prognosticate other key products lifetime in aerospace and other field.

articleTitle: An improved Multicast Routing Algorithm in Ad Hoc network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: The paper present a method utilizing power variation to predict the topology changing and link state which are used to improve ODMRP Multicast Routing Algorithm. The improved protocol reduces the routing failure number and the delivery delay and enhances the performance of network in frequently changing topology conditions.

articleTitle: A user authentication scheme based on dynamic password for wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: In recent years the user authentication becomes a hot issue in the researches of WSNs. It's a critical issue but not an easy one due to the special features of WSNs, such as resource-constrained, limited battery power and so on. In this paper, a two-factor user authentication scheme based on dynamic password is presented by using one-way hash function and exclusive-OR operations. Analysis results show that the scheme is simple, practicable, and also can provide a certain safety user authentication to WSNs.

articleTitle: A novel robust watermarking scheme based on neural network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: A color image oblivious watermarking scheme based on neural network and discrete wavelet transform (DWT) is proposed in this paper. Three identical watermarks and some different expanded bit streams are adaptively embedded into the low frequency sub-bands generated from three channels for a color image, respectively. Due to the adaptive learning capabilities of neural network, the expanded bit streams could be used to train back propagation (BP) neural networks to represent the relationship among the neighbor wavelet coefficients. Based on the trained neural networks, three watermarking results can be extracted and then are voted to decide the final watermark. Extensive experiments illustrate that the new scheme possesses good robustness against different attacks including noise addition, shearing, scaling, luminance and distortion. And what's more, the scheme has excellent performance in term of imperceptibility and resistance to JPEG compression.

articleTitle: Research and design of the workflow engine based on Web services
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: The business process can be significantly improved and optimized with the applications of workflow engine, and the business process control can be well implemented. According to solute the problem of the automation of workflow and the construction of process application, the technology of workflow engine of the workflow middleware in business platform is studied. The technology of Web service is analyzed. A new workflow engine based on Web services is provided in this paper. The structure model of this workflow engine is designed. The architecture and the parts of the workflow engine are provided.

articleTitle: A Knowledge based method for Data Flow Analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: Data Flow Analysis (DFA) is essential in software engineering tasks such as program verification, compiler optimization, and program understanding. Knowledge based methods for problem solving admit highly efficient and understandable problem description. This paper proposes a novel Answer Set Programming (ASP) based solution to the DFA of imperative programs. Given a program, all knowledge necessary for DFA is produced automatically. With answer set solvers such as DLV, SMODELS and CMODELS, the analysis results could be generated automatically. Several experiments are conducted to show the applicability and efficiency of our method. It is shown that the ASP based DFA method is very suitable for quick formulation and solving of DFA problem.

articleTitle: TADC: Thread-aware Divide-and-Conquer policy to manage shared cache
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: Modern Chip Multiprocessors (CMPs) contain multiple cores in a single chip and these cores share last-level cache (LLC). When applications with different memory access behaviors compete for the shared LLC, conventional Least Recently Used (LRU) management policy leads to performance degradation. Applications with different memory access behaviors compete for the shared LLC in different ways, and many researchers have proposed various techniques to improve the performance of the entire CMPs. In this work, we propose a new cache replacement policy (we name it the TADC) that eliminates the side effects brought by streaming applications and judiciously allocate precious LLC resources to those applications that can benefit from additional cache ways. This new policy equally divides each cache set into several subsets whose number is equal to the number of applications running on the CMPs and maps each subset to each application. It detects the memory access behaviors of different applications in different intervals. And it determines different insertion and promotion policies in different subsets according to their owners' memory access behaviors in the last interval. This new policy can also support inter-core capacity stealing. The proposed TADC improves the total Instruction Per Cycle (IPC) throughput as much as 24.3% and 5.94% (on average 7.48% and 3.00%) over the baseline LRU policy for Dual-Core workloads and Quad-Core workloads respectively.

articleTitle: Automatic target recognition based on neutral networks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: Several researches published about artificial neural networks are connected with military problems. This research put forward ideas connected with the processing of military information to search and identify targets-automatic target recognition (ATR). A main-purpose automatic target recognition system did not exist. The research put forward here was demonstrated on military data, however it could only be considered as a proof of principle until systems were fielded and proven “under-fire”. A TR data could be in the form of non-imaging one-dimensional sensor returns, such as ultra-high range resolution radar returns for air-to-air automatic target recognition and vibration signatures from laser radar for recognition of ground targets. The ATR data could be two-dimensional images. The most common ATR images were infrared, but current systems might also deal with synthetic aperture radar images. Finally, the data could be three-dimensional, such as sequences of multiple exposures taken over time from a no stationary world.

articleTitle: An efficient sensor-mission assignment algorithm based on dynamic alliance and quantum genetic algorithm in wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: In wireless sensor networks, there are often several missions that start and finish at different time need to be handled at some time. Schemes that assign sensor resources to mission demands thus become necessary. In order to adapt to the dynamic characteristic of the missions, a management mechanism, named dynamic alliance, is used in the network to organize the nodes. Moreover, since the effective assignment of nodes to missions is a NP-complete problem, a novel quantum genetic algorithm is proposed to solve it. To the best our knowledge, this paper is the first one that researches how to realize the sensor-mission assignment by dynamic alliance and quantum genetic algorithm. Simulation results show that our approach is better than previous algorithms.

articleTitle: A efficient algorithm for the discrete-time LQR optimal control problem
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: In this paper, a new efficient algorithm is proposed to the discrete-time LQR optimal control problem. And a perturbation bound for the solution is derived.

articleTitle: On the quasi-maximal solution of a special matrix equation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: In this paper, a new algorithm is proposed to compute the special positive definite solution which is the unique solution of a special matrix equation. The new algorithm outperforms the existing algorithms for solving the matrix equation in computational costs.

articleTitle: Intrusion detection based on SVM and decision fusion
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: Feature selection and classifier are two important issues in intrusion detection to achieve high performance. This paper proposes intrusion detection scheme based on feature selection with different feature selection methods. Then the extracted features are employed by Support Vector Machine (SVM) for classification. But in fact, single classifier doesn't attain satisfying performance. To address the problem, independent classification outcomes are aggregated through different decision fusion strategy. To examine the feasibility of the scheme, several experiments have been done on dataset in KDD-99. Results indicate the high detection accuracy for intrusion attacks and low false alarm rate of the reliable system.

articleTitle: An improved RED algorithm in the network congestion
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: In the network communication, Mainly uses the RED algorithm to solve network congestion. But in the RED algorithm, the packet loss rate is linear with the average queue flength. The result is that the packet loss rate is bigger when the network congestion is not more serious, and the packet loss rate is smaller when the network congestion is more serious. That reduces the congestion control. For those reasons, the RED algorithm is improved by changing P<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">b</inf> expression, when the average queue length is near the minimum threshold value, the growth of packet loss rate is relatively smaller, near the maximum threshold value, the growth of packet loss rate is more, to avoid the global synchronization of the network. Simulation with NS-2.30 confirms that the IMPRED (improved RED) algorithm can improve network throughput, reduce delay jitter, make the network more stable.

articleTitle: Surface reconstruction from scattered point cloud based on RBF and POU
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: A method for surface reconstruction from scattered point cloud based on the combination of RBF and POU is proposed. First, point cloud is decomposed into a set of slightly overlapping subdomains in the form of binary tree. Next, local reconstruction functions are evaluated by using radial basis functions in each subdomain. Then, the global reconstruction function is obtained by weighted blending of these local reconstruction functions. Finally, the implicit surface is visualized by using Bloomenthal method. The experiments prove that the surfaces resulted from the proposed method are continuous and smooth.

articleTitle: Multi-focus image fusion algorithm based on Nonsubsampled Contourlet Transform
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: A Multi-focus Image Fusion(MFIF) Algorithm based on Nonsubsampled Contourlet Transform (NSCT) is proposed in this paper, which can select the fusion low-frequency coefficients via the Regional Energy Ratio (RER) algorithms. The NSCT is a flexible multi-scale, multi-direction and shift invariant image decomposition, which is suitable for representing images bearing abundant detail and direction information, the NSCT can also avoid introducing ringing artifacts to fused images compared to ordinary method. This is employed for fusing the directional high-frequency coefficients. For the direction high-frequency coefficient, the maximum of the regional energy is used to select the better coefficient for fusion. Experimental results show that the proposed method achieves better fusion efficiency compared to fusion methods based on wavelet transform and contourlet transform respectively.

articleTitle: The forecasting upon demand for tourist guides based on BP neural network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: This paper comprehensively considered all kinds of factors that influenced the demand for tourist guides in some tourist cities. It built a model to forecast the demand for tourist guide on the base of BP neural network. It took the tourist city,Guilin as the case study to verify the effectiveness of the method and this forecasting model.

articleTitle: Concurrent transmissions by Bayesian interference game in wireless ad hoc networks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: The paper proposes a decentralized concurrently transmission strategy in a single-channel by non-cooperate game. Firstly, we formulate a channel access game model, which considers multiple nodes concurrent transmissions in a single-channel for wireless ad hoc networks. We identify the utility function balanced throughput and cost, and then calculate a Nash equilibrium solution (NES) as the transmission threshold. It allows each node to determine whether or not it is feasible to transmit concurrently depending on channel conditions. We prove the existence and uniqueness of a Bayesian Nash Equilibrium Solution of the game, and compute it using numerical methods. Simulation results show the proposed approach is feasible. On the basis, we propose multiple concurrent transmissions framework by game theory for wireless ad hoc networks. The framework enables multiple transmissions to proceed concurrently in a single-channel, which improves network throughput and bandwidth efficiency.

articleTitle: Several wireless network implement mode and security analyse
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: Along with raptly development of wireless join technique, it's network security problem is increasing austerity. This paper introduces several relative mature network joining techniques at present, systemic explains wireless network security problem aiming at distinct techniques, proposes rational advices for security safety, and offers consult for security safety of multiform wireless network joining.

articleTitle: Analysis of decimator for the Spaceborne Fourier Transform Spectrometer
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: SBFTS is capable of high temporal resolution by using two 64 × 64 sample FPAs. It will definitely lead to large amount of data, which is a heavy burden for data transferring. This paper introduced a general approach of decimation. Three types of antialiasing filters have been investigated. The effect of different antialiasing filters has been compared and evaluated. The input data rate 114.688 Mbps has been reduced to 57.344 Mbps. HB filter provided the attenuation performance less than 0.008. And it took only 26 slices to implement the decimation process. Compared with CIC and FIR, HB filter is a better choice considering system requirements. Although this preliminary investigation is still at laboratory level, both the simulation and hardware testing give us confidence to go on our research further.

articleTitle: A classification method based on PAM algorithm and discrete preprocess
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: Based on using clustering method to generate training set, and applying rough set theory to discretization preprocess, the classification accuracy can be improve well. This paper presents a new classification method which combines partititioning around mediod (PAM) with discretization preprocess, it builds the train sets from original sample by using algorithm of partititioning around mediod, then discretes train sets by using discrete algorithm of combination of Boolean logic and rough set theory, and trains classifier by the discrete training sets. The experimental result shows that, in confront of same data sets, compared of getting representative data to train decision tree only through method of partititioning around mediod, the new method can produce higher classification accuracy, and use a smaller amount of the train set.

Author Keywords: discrete algorithms based on combination of Boolean logic and rough set theory

articleTitle: Research on MAS-ITS society behavior coordination model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: ITS is a typical multi-Agent system, subsystem in ITS is looked as agent, which comprise various granularity agent within each agent, simultaneity. In order to solve coordination of MAS-ITS, we use a society behavior coordination model.

articleTitle: A taxonomy of software security defects for SST
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: Software security test (SST) is a useful way to validate software system security attribute. Defects based testing technologies are more effective than traditional specification testing technologies, and more and more researchers pay their attention to the testing methods. Before testing, an organized list of actual defects is especially essential. But at present the only existing suitable taxonomies are mostly for software designers or tool-builders, and do not adequately represent security defects that are found in modern software. In our work, we have coalesced previous efforts to categorize security errors as well as problem reports in order to create a kind of security defects taxonomy. We correlate this taxonomy with available information about current Top 10 software dangerous errors, which come from CWE, SANS and other authoritative vulnerabilities enumerations. We suggest that this taxonomy is suitable for software security testers and to outline possible areas of future research.

articleTitle: Research on dynamic recommendation trust based on GC-TOPSIS in grid
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: In order to effectively reduce the impact of malicious recommendation, this paper designs a method of dynamic recommendation trust based on the gray correlation technique for order preference by similarity to ideal solution (GCTOPSIS). First, we determine the combined weights of each node attribute by using AHP and entropy method. Next, we use the gray correlation analysis to calculate the gray correlation relative closeness degree (GCRCD) of the recommendation nodes and the reference nodes, and sort all the recommendation nodes according to the GCRCD. Finally, according to the importance of the interaction between the nodes, we can dynamically select the recommendation nodes and obtain the set of the trusted recommendation nodes. The experiment shows the method can filter out the malicious nodes, thus effectively reducing the impact of malicious recommendation.

articleTitle: New constructions of hierarchical identity-based encryption in the standard model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: In this paper, a new hierarchical identity-based encryption scheme(HIBE) is proposed at first. The proposed scheme is constructed in the generalized selective-ID model without using the random oracles. Under the decision bilinear Diffie-Hellman inversion (decision BDHI) assumption, the scheme is provably secure against chosen plaintext attacks(CPA). Furthermore, we convert it to a constant size ciphertext scheme and reduce its security to the l-DBDHI problem.

articleTitle: Pinning scheme for complex networks based on PageRank Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: The pinning control problem of complex networks has been widely investigated recent years. However, there does not exist a widely accepted pinning scheme which can be applied to the synchronization of complex networks. This contribution gives a novel pinning scheme which based on the famous PageRank algorithm to make the network realize synchronization as fast as possible. Numerical simulation indicates that this pinning scheme is effective for undirected networks, however, it fails when it applied to directed networks.

articleTitle: The design of handhold experiment score login system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: Aimed at the multi-disciplinary electronic circuit experiment teaching, a new handhold experiment score login system is designed. The system framework structure and implementation are also described. The teacher can login experiment scores by wireless sense in the teaching process through this system. This system can generate experiment registry and summary, and then store them in the teacher's PC automatically.

articleTitle: A novel dual-threshold denoising method by the wavelet transform
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: Currently image denoising uses various threshold methods based on wavelet transform. In this paper, we propose an effective and novel dual-threshold denoising method that uses a piecewise and nonlinear function and selects two thresholds for every image subband, noise threshold T<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</inf> and signal threshold T<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">s</inf>. Then we further study the subband coefficients: those which are lower than T<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</inf> are noises and will be removed, those which are higher than T<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">s</inf> are signals and will be retained and those which are between T<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</inf> and T<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">s</inf> will be handled by their “intensity factors”. The method powerfully distinguishes the noise and the signal, overcomes the limitations of the traditional methods of the wavelet denoising using single threshold to deal with the coefficients. Experiments show that the method is better than other traditional ones in terms of SNR and visual effects.

articleTitle: On update-mechanism algorithm of Online Traveling Salesman Problems
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: An online TSP which is described in this paper is to find a optimal Hamiltonian cycle in a real-time weighted symmetric graph. The real-time is that the weight of edge can be changed continuously and the method can answered rapidly to adjust the routes. A hybrid strategy which is based on the tabu search and genetic algorithm is proposed in this paper and an update operator is added into the strategy. Experiments using the 30-city of China TSP shows that the proposed method is superior and feasibility.

articleTitle: Urban ecological traffic evaluation based on matter element analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: Through comprehensive analysis to urban traffic system, it raises an evaluation system. The theoretical frame of ecological traffic evaluation is presented. On the basis of setting up grade evaluation, it adopts membership function and gets quantized evaluation index of urban ecological traffic. Because performance of the common measure that can't be common between different indices, it utilize matter element matrix to make the indices standardization. Matter element matrix can solve the uncertain and incompatible problem of the evaluated factors in assessing urban ecological traffic. The comprehensive appraisal model of urban ecological traffic is set up by using matter element analysis theory. It is pointed out that the environmental carrying capacity can be increased through developing a rational transport structure and establishing a scientific urban land utilization modal. Thus the eco-city can be developed, and the sustainable development of transportation can be realized. And it carries a comprehensive appraisal on the existing ecological traffic for one city. The evaluation results indicate that the existing ecological traffic of this city belongs to `tree grades' which is identical with the real expert evaluation results.

articleTitle: The design of film thickness measure system based on capacitance sensor
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: According to the practical needs, a film thickness measure system based on capacitance sensor are designed integrated with the features of this kind of sensor. In this thesis, first analyzed the measure principle of capacitance sensor, and introduced the each component of this system, following elaborated working principle of high precision capacitance/ voltage converter IC CAV444 and its circuit design, at last, displayed the result of the overall test. The results showed this system can well measure the film thickness with the Precision higher than 1 um, and can be widely used in online inspection of non-metallic material.

articleTitle: The recursive inversion of nonlinear control of a four-dimensional hyperchaotic system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: With the expansion of the chaotic application fields, more control method have greater value and significance. In order to better expand the field of chaos control, A four-dimensional nonlinear dynamic system was constructed and its complex dynamic characteristics of chaotic was analysed, including the phase trajectory map, Lyapunov index, Poincaré map and so on, through the analysis of these characteristics proved that the chaotic system is a hyperchaotic system. Then it use the recursive non-linear inverse method to design a linear controller.And then, the hyperchaotic system reaches a steady state by using MATLAB simulation. The result shows that the recursive inversion control method can be very good in the chaos' control, it make the super-chaotic system achieve a steady state. It also demonstrates that there is a big potential application value in the field of chaos control by using the recursive inversion of control method.

articleTitle: Research on optimal fingerprint input algorithm in mobile phone
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: As mobile phone brings great exchanges to our life, there are more and more information security problems. The uniqueness and security of fingerprint make it possible to be applied to identification of mobile phone. By analyzing the Atrua-Wing algorithm defects, the paper proposes optimal algorithm which adds matching limits to the input template. This optimal algorithm can ensure that the template is correct, improves the effect of the template and accelerates the speed of identification.

articleTitle: An energy-efficient protocol architecture with multiple clustering for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: Wireless Sensor Network (WSN), provides versatile computing platforms for the applications such as environmental monitoring and military field surveillance. The WSN deployed in these applications are usually faced with harsh environments which makes it very hard or impossible to recharge their node batteries. So it is necessary to fabricate specific protocol for WSN to enable its nodes efficiently utilize their energy. Motivated by this practical demand, a hierarchical protocol architecture with multiple clustering for WSN is proposed in this paper. A distributed multiple clustering policy, in which the nodes are chosen to be act as the cluster heads in certain probability, is applied to enables the self organization of large numbers of nodes. These cluster heads constitute the routing infrastructure and aggregate data from their neighboring non-cluster nodes. Among the cluster heads, the one with more residual energy is picked out to be the super node. The cluster heads does not need to transfer information directly to the base station but to the super node through which the information will be transferred to the base station. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed approach is effective in prolonging the network lifecycle and supporting scalable data aggregation.

articleTitle: Normalized cut as basic tool for remote sensing image
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: Some remote sensing image segmentation algorithm can not make full use of local and global information and Normalized has NP-hard problem. In order to solve the problems, image can be described through the graph model and the Normalized cut can be used to cut graph for image segmentation. Watershed algorithm is applied to create the initial segments, and then Normalized cut is used to segment among regions. Experimental result shows that the method is effective.

articleTitle: Study on modern spectrum analysis system for mechanical fault diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: There are few modern spectrum analysis systems available on the literature for mechanical fault diagnosis. In this paper we develop a modern spectrum analysis system to identification fault characteristic from vibration signal of complex mechanical systems. The system is tested on several typically examples in engineering. It is shown that the presented system can be performance well in actual engineering structures and may also be applied to the signal processing in electronic or communication systems.

articleTitle: A Market Oriented Grid Model based on contract management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: With the rapid development and wide application of information technologies, computing has being transformed to a model in which services are commoditized and delivered in a manner similar to traditional utilities such as water, electricity, gas, and telephony. Compared with recently focused Cloud Computing, Market Oriented Computing still has its own peculiar applied demand and applied environment. A Market Oriented Grid Model (MOGM) based on contract management is proposed in this paper. Here MOGM is constructed and managed as a market where users trade resources as needed. GMACD (a Grid Market Architecture based on Contract management and third-party Depository service) proposed by us acts the market manager in MOGM, serves all users by building virtual markets, formulating trade rules, managing and motoring the market operations. Contract management mechanism and Third-party payment mechanism are two highlights in the design of MOGM. The contracts attributions, operations, and states involved in the former as well as the funds variety and funds flow involved in the latter are discussed in detail. The contract state transitions and the triggering events are modeled based on Petri-Net. These mechanisms place all transactions under the management of contract specifications, and help keeping the whole market in benign operation.

articleTitle: A design of UHF RFID reader system with multiple fieldbus
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: This paper have designed a kind of UHF RFID based on ISO/IEC 18000-6B standard and supporting multiple fieldbus. Hardware were mainly introduced from the reader hardware and fieldbus control module circuits, and software were respectively introduced from system master programs and bus receiver and launching system software. With the development of RFID, developing supporting fieldbus UHF RFID has some prospect.

articleTitle: Study of comprehensive evaluation method of undergraduates based on data mining
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: With expansion of university enrollment, the number of students increases every year, and information of their courses, scores and normal performance records also shows rapid expansion. More and more data of undergraduates have to be stored in database or data warehouse with the capacity increasing. It is difficult for teachers to finish comprehensive evaluation of over ten thousand students at the same time with the traditional methods of average scores, weighted average marks or Grade Point Average. The traditional ways are of some disadvantages of large error propagation, close results, small discrimination, low efficiency and poor scalability when facing mass assess data. Therefore, a new comprehensive evaluation method based on data mining of database or data warehouse of undergraduates is proposed. The method is carried out by decision tree algorithms. The results of case reveals that the decision tree algorithms of data mining technology can distinguish between the merits of the level of university students and realize the classification comprehensive evaluation, and the problem that the traditional methods are not fit for the student assessment of too much records and mass data is solved. The new method is of greater efficiency. It's an effective complement to traditional evaluation methods.

articleTitle: Studies on data analysis of piezoelectric transducer and its matching
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: A method is presented for testing the characteristic parameters such as the best serial resonant point, bandwidth, quality factor using the admittance circle diagram and common laboratory instruments. Based on that, match the transducer to make the transducer resonant at the best working band with the largest amplitude and best waveform, which plays a significant role in wireless communication, especially in underwater acoustics communication systems.

articleTitle: Fast mode selection for H.264/AVC based on MB motion characteristics
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: The latest video-coding standard H.264/AVC, which adopts rate distortion optimization (RDO), can achive better coding efficiency. However, several techniques, such as inter mode and intra mode selection need to check all the prediction modes. So, it will greatly increase computational complexity. In this paper, a fast algorithm based on the quantization parameter and the macroblock motion characteristics was proposed to reduce the compoexity of the encoder. The results show that this fast algorithm can reduces about 60.636% computing time than the full search algorithm with only 0.056dB loss in PSNR and 0.37% increment on the total bit.

articleTitle: Adaptive control for a class of uncertain nonlinear system with input magnitude and rate saturation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: This article presents a new adaptive controller for a class of uncertain multiple-input multiple-output nonlinear systems with input magnitude and rate saturation. To deal with input saturation, an auxiliary system is constructed. With the auxiliary system, a modified tracking error is defined and used in parameters update laws. The stability properties of the proposed controller are obtained via Lyapunov analysis. The bounds of steady states tracking error and transient tracking error are obtained. An numerical example is given to illustrate the efficiency of the design method.

articleTitle: Dynamic Route Scheduling for Optimization of Cloud Database
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: Cloud Computing is developing as a key computing platform for sharing resources. How to effectively route storage resource in cloud is so difficulty. This paper presents Cloud Computing Dynamic Route Scheduling for Optimization of Cloud Database for enhancing the efficiency searching database of cloud computing.

articleTitle: Design and research on Knowledge Management-Oriented OA architecture
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: The 21st century will be the century of knowledge, and then knowledge management plays an increasingly important role in economic life. Knowledge Management-Oriented OA (Office Automation), whose connotation and extension have entirely changed, breaks through traditional limitations caused by Official Document-Oriented OA. Keeping an eye on the latest IT application technology, we will research the physical and software platform of Knowledge Management-Oriented OA System and discuss how to build an OA architecture which is multilayer, efficient and maintainable in this paper. Finally, we illustrate the validity, scientificity and rationality of the platform by a specific OA system in a group company.

articleTitle: A locator based on DSP for the hollow intramedullary nail
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: A new design of positioning device for the hollow intramedullary nail is presented, which is based on profiled magnetic body. The design uses sensing technology, information capture and processing, DSP fuzzy control technology. A new method of the high-temperature disinfection of signal source and sensor is introduced. The clinical application shows that it has a lower positioning error in thighbone-tibia surgery and meets the need of required precision in surgical operation. The new device not only shortens the operation period, but also alleviates suffering of patients, and the new design has high value of clinical applications.

articleTitle: TCP performance in UWB WPAN with asymmetric link
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: In this paper, we analyzed TCP performance in UWB WPAN by establishing UWB test-bed. Impact of asymmetry between forward link and reverse link was concerned. Furthermore, we analyzed relationship between TCP throughput and reverse link bandwidth. Our study demonstrated that available resource of reverse link impacts TCP performance seriously. In addition, it was found that there is an optimal reverse bandwidth for continuous TCP service when error rate is fixed.

articleTitle: An architecture for integrating wireless sensor networks into IP network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: In the recent years, there is a growing interest in the design and deployment of sensor systems for applications of high-level inference, which leads to an increasing demand on connecting Internet Protocol (IP) network users to wireless sensor networks and accessing the available services and applications. In this paper, To overcome the shortcomings of existing P2P-based integrating architecture for wireless sensor networks, a novel three layers P2P-based integrating architecture for wireless sensor networks is proposed. It builds a bottom-up three layers network model for the sensor network: sensor nodes layer, gateway peers layer and super peers layer. The system's communication model is based on a P2P approach to lower communication complexity. For these reasons, the life cycle of wireless sensor networks is prolonged.

articleTitle: The robust optimization of the capacitated hub and spoke airline network design base on ant colony algorithms
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: This paper discusses the capacitated hub and spoke airline network design problem. Against the uncertainty of cost and traffic, a mathematical model is established using robust optimization method. In view of the characteristic of robust solution as well as the question complexity, an ant colony algorithm with human study behavior (HACA) was put forward. Finally, the algorithm is tested by an example.

articleTitle: Improved chromosome encoding for genetic-algorithm-based assembly sequence planning
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: In order to ensure every feasible assembly sequence is included in the searching space of genetic algorithm, this paper proposes an improved genetic encoding method. In this method, every chromosome is encoded by a permutation of integer. Although the final form of chromosome is the same as the existing form, the decoding process is different. In our decoding process, every permutation of integer is transformed into an ordered set of all edges in the stability-directed graph, and then the ordered set of edges is transform into an ordered set of assembly states. The correctness of this method is proved, the combination of this method and the existing genetic algorithm is discussed, and an example is presented to show the effectiveness of our encoding method.

articleTitle: An automatic 3D face mesh transform based on point matching and its application
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: In order to achieve two 3D face mesh automatic transform, two 3D face with different topological structures are regarded as two point sets and then an automatic mesh transform method based on point matching is proposed. Firstly iterative closest point is used to align two 3D face vertex sets, then the TPS(thin-plate spline) and deterministic annealing algorithm can be used for point registration to implement automatic mesh transform, at last Kriging interpolation is applied to enhance similarity between resulted mesh and source mesh. In the end, we implement the system in VC++6.0 and OpenGL environments, and transform the default face mesh to a realistic image in Second Life using the system we established.

articleTitle: Research of routing algorithm for wireless sensor network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: The wireless sensor network is composed of many low price sensor nodes, these sensor nodes form multi-hop wireless network and complete the large-scale sensing task in cooperation. The wireless sensor network has a widespread application prospect, it has attracted people's universal attention. In this paper, the traditional wireless sensor network's routing algorithm is analyzed and a directed routing tree algorithm based on improved flooding is proposed. This algorithm applied flooding strategy to construct a directed sink tree with the sinks as the root, and then inquired the neighboring nodes through agent, if the node was no longer in the adjacent, the search would be taken around this node, finally the route was repaired.

articleTitle: Improved PSO algorithm and its application in optimal design for Rectifier Transformer
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: An improved partial swarm optimization (IPSO) algorithm has been presented to overcome the defect of trapping in local optimum in the PSO algorithm. In the IPSO, swarm A is selected to do particle swarm optimization (PSO), and the maximum number of iterations should be divided into several stages, a new swarm B will be generated randomly outside of swarm A according to the constraints on specific issues at the end of each stage, and the swarm B also obey the PSO. In the next iteration stage of swarm A, the better result through comparison of the swarm B and A will be chosen to update the current optimization result of swarm A. Then swarm A continues to calculate, after repeated comparison to find the optimal solution. The IPSO is applied to the optimization of Rectifier Transformer designation. The feasibility and validity of the proposed method are proved by the contrast between handwork results and IPSO results.

articleTitle: The design and implementation of Signal Integrity test vector generation based on JTAG
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: With intensive study on IEEE std1149.1, and the basic idea of HTF(Half Transition) Fault Mode, an architecture for SI(Signal Integrity) test vector based on extended JTAG is designed and realized. The implementation of the idea is that, The advantage of the new instruction is that on the base of fully complied with IEEE1149.1 standard, it have been added to extend the function of boundary-scan architecture and provide the support to SI testing.

articleTitle: Generalized control and synchronization of two identical chaotic systems
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: In this paper,we investigate generalized control and synchronization between two identical chaotic systems:the classic Lorenz system and hyperchaotic Chen system based on the active control method and Lyapunov stability theory. Numerical simulations are used to verify the effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on the anti-virus system of military network based on cloud security
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Viewing transform of image based on vanishing point
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: Projective geometry is an effective tool for shape transform of images in computer vision. It contains too many degrees of freedom, and the feature points must be chosen semi-automatically. In order to solve these problems, an improved algorithm of viewing transform with fixed viewpoint based on vanishing point is proposed. First, the relationship model of viewing angle and vanishing point is created. Then, the new method chooses the feature points automatically by detecting vanishing points. Finally, a shape transform based on panning and tilting is made. The test results of two types of images and comparison with other methods demonstrate the applicability and effectiveness of this algorithm.

articleTitle: An algorithm proving the resource-allocation-graph algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: By analyzing the resource allocation graph algorithm, we state that the soundess of the algorithm depends on a fact: different simplification sequences of the resource allocation graph lead to a same Non-reducible graph. By analyzing the essence of the resource allocation algorithm, we give another algorithm to verify the resource-allocation-graph algorithm.

articleTitle: Petri net based model for concurrent control of database system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: In order to represent a clear and compact formal specification for concurrency control of transactions in database system, Petri net based concurrency control representation model is presented. This model satisfies two-phase locking protocol which can ensure the serialization of concurrency scheduling. Hence the problems resulted from concurrent operations are avoided.

articleTitle: Period analysis based on SVM and wavelet variance for time series
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: In the time series period analysis, the period obtained by the maximal wavelet variance has serious errors. In this paper, we present a method of LS-SVM to approximate the wavelet variance or power spectrum at different scales, and then obtain the period of sequence by estimating the maximum value. The experiment indicates that LS-SVM method can approximate wavelet variance effectively, and can estimate the period of the time series accurately. It is an effective method for time series period analysis and power spectral analysis.

articleTitle: Cluster synchronization in non-diffusively coupled networks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: Using Lyapunov function approach, some sufficient conditions about the existence and global asymptotic stability of a cluster synchronization invariant-manifold in a non-diffusively coupled network are derived. The effectiveness of the sufficient conditions is illustrated by an example. In addition, the example also shows that cluster number can vary as coupling strength varies.

articleTitle: An improved schedule of MapReduce programming environment in cloud computing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: Background processing technology is the overall protection of cloud computing system. Large-scale data processing technology plays a key role in background data collection and arrangement of the cloud computing. Google's MapReduce programming mode is a parallel programming model, widely used in processing and generating large data sets, and its scheduling mechanism is an important part of the model. In this article, the implementation process of MapReduce programming environment is analyzed, and a improvement in scheduling mechanisms is proposed.

articleTitle: A result-set-based algorithm for haplotype reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: Most algorithms proposed in the literature for individual haplotyping problem try to generate a single pair of haploytpes with the highest accuracy in terms of certain specific optimization criteria. However, due to the limitations of models, the result produced by these algorithms may not be the real best one, which leads to a low reconstruction rate for the pair of constructed haplotypes. This paper starts with a thorough analysis on the reasons for how the real best result can be lost during a haplotyping process based on the minimum error correction (MEC) model. We propose a new idea to reduce the probability of losing the best result by generating a small set of optimal results (which will be called an optimal result set), instead of a single optimal result. Based on this idea, a practical parthenogenetic algorithm PGA-SET is presented to solve the MEC model. The short chromosome code and small size population of PGA-SET algorithm ensure that it can obtain a relatively small optimal result set. Experimental results indicate that the set contains no more than 7 results in general, and which contains at least a pair of haplotypes that has higher reconstruction rate than those generated by previous algorithms solving the MEC model. This strongly suggests that the idea of generating a small optimal result set may effectively avoid losing the real best result, and PGA-SET algorithm is a practical method based on this idea.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of home remote monitor system based on embedded system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: This paper introduced a remote monitor system of information appliance, it bases on the microprocessor of S3C2410 as the main controller and Linux as the embedded operate system. It represents the main function and composition of this system, through mounting the Web Server Boa and setting up the embedded remote visit and monitoring platform. Adopting HTML to design friendly man-machine interface. After completing the loading of USB camera driving and transplanting the video server, user can call on page of web server by web browser, implementing the monitoring of appliance by the internet.

articleTitle: Automatic mining of distinguishers with unknown protocol format
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: Unknown protocol inference are useful for many security application, including intrusion detection which always depends on deep packet inspection. However, mining distinguishers with unknown protocol format generally turns to protocol reverse engineering. In this paper, we propose a novel method for automatically abstracting protocol distinguishers based on statistic and our method is proved to be a good tool in finding protocol specifications. To implement and validate our method, we deign a serial of experiments. Then, applied to analyze of the indicators - recall is 99% while precise equals 99.9%, the method was proved highly efficient in the real-world environment.

articleTitle: Fingerprint image denoising using morphological amoebas
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: This paper deals with noisy problem in the fingerprint images. With the help of pilot images from Canny edge detection, the method of morphological amoebas can simultaneously reduces noises and keeps useful details by filtering images with non-fixed kernels, outperforms classical morphological operations and other filters with fixed, space-invariant structuring element. What's more, even the approach needs computing the structuring elements for every point in the image, the run-time speed of this algorithm is still faster than some nonlinear algorithms. Finally, a practice with satisfactory result proves that this method do work effectively.

articleTitle: Application of probability density estimation criteria in speaker recognition
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: With the rapid development of computer technology, speaker recognition has been widely used and researched. In this paper, a traditional code book based on VQ algorithm was improved by applying in probability density estimation criteria method. Through the method, the problem of easily falling into local optimum existing in traditional LBG codebook can be well solved, and controlling operation can be easily achieved. Experimental results show that improved codebook algorithm has less distortion than traditional LBG algorithm.

articleTitle: One method of rapid search using character encoding to transform the character into long integer
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: The general method of search is the sequential match. The sequential search is inefficient when the amount of the data is large. One method of rapid search using character encoding to transform the character into long integer is given, and it is designed and analyzed in this paper. It is indicated by the experimental result that the efficient of this search's method has improved when the amount of the data is large, much data are certain and the fact that the length of data is longer than 8 bytes is few.

articleTitle: A real-time medical assistance billing system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: To further improve the urban and rural medical assistance system and make it much more convenient in the emergent case, we designed and developed a real-time medical assistance billing system for Linchuan county civil affairs bureau. This system consists of two medical assistance models, one of which is real-time assistance model that realizes a “seamless combination” of the civil affairs assistance system and the two existing systems: the rural cooperative medical care system and hospital billing system. It provides the direct settlement for the medical assistance at hospital, thus solving the problem that some poor people have no money to pay the bill for the medical treatment. This paper begins with the introduction of the design guideline of the medical assistance system, followed by the design of the system function modules. Furthermore, it presents the detailed solution to some key technology in the system, including system deployment, data security and data consistency problem of the civil affairs bureau database and the hospital database and so on.

articleTitle: The construction of public security information management platform in Guangxi: Based on digital planning
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: Digital planning is the combination of traditional planning theories and modern information technology. It is a brand-new planning concept, as well as an essential component in digital urban planning.
