The digitalization of public security information management, which is a complicated and systematic construction, is one of the trends during the whole process of information age. The construction of public security information management platform is of great importance in Guangxi Autonomous region, since a series of problems have arisen in the construction of pubic security information management. This paper poses a scheme of the management platform for the pubic security information management in Guangxi, in the expectation of improving the efficiency in the public information management.

articleTitle: Research on health state monitoring and diagnosis approach for aerocraft structure
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: To monitor effectively the aerocraft structure fatigue damages, discover in good time hidden trouble, avoid fearful accident occurring, the advanced acoustic emission (AE) technology is used to monitor the aerocraft structure health state. The variance of the wavelet packet decomposition coefficients to the gathered AE signals are extracted as the aerocraft structure robust health state feature vectors. And the fuzzy Kohonen cluster network health state monitoring system is designed to diagnose the aerocraft health state. A new kind of aerocraft structure health state diagnosis approach, based on AE information variance feature vector and fuzzy cluster network, is proposed in this paper. Experiments show that the approach has good performance to monitor and diagnose the fatigue crack in the aerocraft structure components. It presents a new approach to monitor and diagnose the aircraft structure health state.

articleTitle: A new algorithm of layered routing protocol in WSN
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: In wireless sensor networks (WSN), the measurement data of the neighbor nodes often have little differences. In view of this situation, a new algorithm called NNA based on layered routing protocol is proposed. By comparing the measurement data of the node with the cluster head's, if the difference of the data value is less than the threshold value set by the system, then the node will join to the cluster. The cluster-head rotates according to the energy consuming.

articleTitle: Fast large file distribution in data grid
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: With more and more data created by grid computing, large file distribution is a key issue in data grid. Current file distribution in data grid is usually a style site-to-site and this mechanism is not efficient and wastes bandwidth. In this paper, we propose a novel algorithm to distribute large file efficiently in data grid. We split the file into n subfiles and transfer each subfile to a different node. And then the node which receives a subfile transfers the subfile to other nodes. The size of each subfile is different in different network environment. We must compute the size of the subfile using our simple but efficient algorithm before file splitting. To verify the performance of our algorithm, we build a simulation system and compare with Multiunicast and FastReplica [1]. The result shows our algorithm significantly reduce the file distribution time.

articleTitle: Dictionary-based Chinese-Tibetan sentence alignment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: In creation of the Chinese-Tibetan parallel corpus, research of alignment at sentence level is an essential topic. At present, there is no research on Chinese-Tibetan sentence alignment. This paper proposes an automatic approach for Chinese-Tibetan sentence alignment which is based on dictionary. It is a solution to the specific problems encountered in Chinese-Tibetan sentence alignment, which are sentence recognition and problems caused by different granularity between Chinese word segmentation and Tibetan word segmentation in sentence alignment process. Experiment shows the precision of this approach is 84.8%.

articleTitle: Face image synthesis using wavelet transform
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: The paper proposes a novel method to synthesize a multi-meanings face image, which is produced by two target face images with different interpretations according to distinct viewing distance and visual angles. Firstly, the target face images are decomposed by wavelet transform with the scale that is a function of viewing distance and image height. Secondly, the multi-meanings image viewed in distinct visual angles is reconstructed by elective composition algorithms and variable weight coefficients. Finally, the resultant images are averaged for noise reduction to achieve compelling visual effect. Experimental results show the efficiency and robustness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Application of multiobjective optimization to the blending of Traditional Chinese Medicine herbs
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: A novel multi-objective optimization method to ensuring the inter-batch quality uniformity by blending different batches of Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) herbs or natural products is presented. Multiple objectives are often preferred by users; however they cannot be attained in a single objective optimization problem. To conquering this drawback, evaluation function is introduced to incorporate multiples objectives so that a new single objective is only needed to be solved. As a demonstration, 10 batches of Radix isatidis with 5 indicative components are used to set a multiobjective optimization problem achieving the goal of the lowest cost and the best quality simultaneously, and results show that an efficient solution can be obtained.

articleTitle: A study of expand role-based access control model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: In this paper, it presents E-RBAC model expanded on the traditional RBAC. The E-RBAC model has two ways of user authorization and introduces user group, module, role priority, it improves the system security and flexibility, reducing the complexity of the permission assignment. The expanded RBAC model can be easily applied to other information systems, now it has practical significance in the management information system.

articleTitle: Study and analysis of data mining technology in college courses students failed
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: This article based on the basic situation of college students' current performance management and elective guidance, introduce the knowledge of data mining, and select the association rules mining algorithm using in the analysis of students failed courses. Find the Associated factors affecting students achievement factors, and provide decision support information for educators. So promote to carry out the intervention scientifically, and improve education quality and the scientific level of University Students work.

articleTitle: Assembly line balancing problem using Particle Swarm Optimization algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: Assembly Line Balancing (ALB) is one of the important problems of production/operations management area. Due to the NP-hard nature of the ALB problem, heuristics are generally used to solve real life problems. This paper presents an approach, based on Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm, to effectively address the assembly line balance problem with the complicating factors of parallel workstations. The method of linearly decreasing the inertia weight of the PSO (LDWPSO) is used in this paper to compare with the standard PSO. Experimental results show that the LDWPSO algorithm is superior to the standard PSO on some assembly line balancing problem.

articleTitle: A family of H∞ controllers for dissipative Hamiltonian systems
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: Without solving Hamilton-Jacobi-Issacs equations, a family of H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> controllers is proposed for dissipative Hamiltonian systems. These controllers are obtained by interconnecting an H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> controller with a generalized ZEG detectable, free generalized Hamiltonian system. Simulations show the effectiveness of the H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> control strategy proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Sawtooth-correlated TOA estimation algorithm based on energy envelope for IR-UWB systems
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: The received signal is composed of a variety of different multipath delayed signals due to the complexity of indoor communications environment. In order to improve accuracy of TOA estimation of first path, a novel TOA estimation algorithm for IR-UWB systems is presented. In this paper, we consider the sawtooth waveform as a local template signal correlate to the received signal to detect the leading-edge path signal, closed-form expressions are derived for TOA estimation. Also, the effect of local template signal's length is analyzed. Performances of different algorithms are compared via simulations.

articleTitle: Wireless mobile community model based on AOC
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: With regard to the research on MANET mobile model and routing protocol issues, according to the behaviors of community mobile nodes, a community wireless mobile model based on AOC. Autonomous system was established by making use of AOC-by-prototyping combining with trial-and-Error process. This paper does simulation experiment through NS-2 simulation platform, showing that in this model DSR and AODV routing protocols are relatively stable in the aspect of routing overhead; however in the window size DSR routing protocol is the best.

articleTitle: A new optimal replica placement strategy in Content Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: The replica placement problems (RPPs) in the Content Distribution Networks have been widely studied. In this paper, the Multiple Minimum Cost Flow Model (MMCFM) with server storage constraints is proposed for the RPPs for the first time. Since traditional minimum cost flow algorithm can not be applied to solve our model, MMCFM is converted to an equivalent Mixed Integer Programming (MIP) and furthermore an Integer Linear Programming (ILP). Branch and Bound Algorithm is used to obtain the optimal solution of ILP. In the simulation part, the performance of our algorithms is shown.

articleTitle: A parallel interference cancellation detection algorithm for VBLAST-OFDM system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: A parallel interference cancellation detection algorithm based on QR decomposition for VBLAST-OFDM system is proposed in this paper. It makes use of the first detection layer and separates it into several parallel branches. The detected signal is eliminated successively from the received vector of each branch, after that, other signals are detected by using QR factorization, but only the last detected signal that has the highest diversity gain is reserved. Finally, the optimal solution of the several branches is selected to be as the final detection result by using partial ML and the performance is improved effectively. Simulation results show that the proposed P-ICQR algorithm is superior to the conventional parallel algorithm, IQRD algorithm, and QR algorithm.

articleTitle: Socially inspired spectrum sharing in cognitive radio networks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: This paper proposes a socially inspired spectrum sharing scheme for a cognitive radio network consisting of several primary users and a secondary user. A primary user may not be willing to share his spectrum with the secondary user if they are not acquaintances. A new concept called spectrum sharing incentive factor (IF) is defined to measure the extent to which the primary user allows the secondary user to share his spectrum. The study is further extended to the case of multiple secondary users. Performance of the proposed schemes are evaluated in terms of access delay. The results show that the proposed schemes incur shorter access delay than the one ignoring social relationship.

articleTitle: Modeling human decision behavior with SOAR and prospect theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: This paper describes an effort to utilizing prospect theory within Soar architecture to build human decision behaviors into Agents. Prospect theory provides a decision-making model of human being. By applying prospect theory in the decision phase of Soar architecture, human decision-making character is integrated into the deduction process of Soar. A example is given at the end of the paper.

articleTitle: Research on information service management mode based on cloud computing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: With the development and progress of information technology, the modern information service is showing such characteristics as digitalized, intelligentized, networking, diversified and standardized. The paper presents the information service management mode based on cloud computing which reforms, improves and expands the traditional service mode by means of cloud computing. It maximizes the use of information resources and tends to meet the various demands of users.

articleTitle: Research on XCP-based structured P2P network traffic control
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: With the extensive using P2P networks, P2P data stream occupied more and more bandwidth, it will affect the performance of the entire Internet. This paper studies the P2P nodes which exchange traffic disorder, through introducing XCP congestion control protocol, designs network region-based exchange unit and flow control strategy to achieve flow control. The simulation results show that the flow control method can ease the P2P data stream.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on intelligent extraction of multi-source spatial data
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Application system design of rectification tower based on Distributed Control System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: The paper focuses on the DCS design of specific rectification tower technological process, SUPCON JX-300X as hardware platforms and the SCKey as software platforms are adopted in the DCS design. The main steps and design key points in the DCS application design process are analyzed, and then detailed description of control scheme, system selection, hardware and software configuration, etc are carried out.

articleTitle: Hybrid control of the distributed refrigeration system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: The supermarket refrigeration system typically has a distributed control structure, which neglects interactions between its subsystems. These interactions from time to time lead to a synchronization operation of the display-cases which causes an inferior control performance and increased energy consumption. The paper focuses on synchronization dynamics of the refrigeration system modeled as a piecewise-affine switched system. System behaviors are analyzed using chaos theory. The synchronization phenomenon is interpreted as a stable low-period orbit; if the system has a high-order periodic orbit or a chaotic behavior, the system is considered away from the synchronization. Therefore, the paper proposes a concept that the system may be de-synchronized by making it chaotic. A de-synchronization scheme is developed. It includes a synchronization-early-monitoring detector by calculating the maximum Lyapunov exponent and a de-synchronization controller by chaotifying the system using the time-delayed impulsive method, essentially a kind of hybrid control.

articleTitle: Research on an energy-efficient and variation-sensitive clustering algorithm for wireless sensor network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: Due to the characteristics of energy-limited, how to reduce the energy consumption of the wireless sensors network has become the crucial point. Research shows that it can reduce energy consumption to organize the nodes in the network into a hierarchical cluster structure. This paper synthetically analyzes several existing cluster algorithms, and then proposes an energy-efficient and variation-sensitive clustering algorithm. This algorithm makes some modification on the basis of some existing classical clustering algorithms. In order to reduce energy consumption, we adopt some special measures to form cluster, elect cluster head and change the way in which the sense data is constantly sent to cluster head by non-cluster head node.

articleTitle: The reconstruction of three-dimensional model algorithm STEP- based in rapid prototyping technology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: The current most STL(stereo lithography)format is widely used as a de facto industry standard in the rapid prototyping industry due to its simplicity and ability to tessellation of almost all surfaces, but some drawbacks such as precision loss, data redundancy and not conducive to concurrent design and the limitations of network synergy lead to unsatisfactory precision of the part in post processing. In order to reduce the above problems, a new processing module of STEP-based neutral exchange of AP203 file data of 3D reconstruction is designed and implication in this paper. Using a dynamic linked list as a data storage structure and dynamically allocating storage space, we successful extracted the information of the neutral file model of geometry and topology. The experiment shows that the speed of reconstruction and display rate were increased.

articleTitle: The measuring and controlling system of shell temperature of human body based on ARM
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: Hypothermia of human body during the medical operation is usually prevented by heat preservation. A control system of shell temperature of human body is developed based on ARM9 2440 embedded processor in this paper, which consists of several intelligence control platforms such as a multi-channel temperature module, a touch sensitive display and control module, an air temperature detection and warming module, and a air flux detection and control module, etc. Experiments are carried out to validate the core modules and the results show that the ideal core temperature of human body can be maintained by controlling the temperature and air flux onto the human skin according to the instant shell temperature.

articleTitle: Towards many-valued logical formalism for peer-to-peer coordination computing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: Peer-to-peer database coordination has been one of important topics in distributed computing. In this paper, we propose a 4-valued logical formalism for both better understanding object behaviors and coordination computing in peer-to-peer networks. Our framework can be used to describe many-valued objects. The result of such expression provides actionable information, and assist in conveying incomplete, inconsistent and overlapping phenomena in P2P network coordination computing.

articleTitle: A novel barrier coverage scheme of WSN based on trajectory prediction
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: For barrier coverage issue of wireless sensor network, we propose a deployment scheme of sensor nodes for intrusion objects whose trajectory could be predicted. We provide the theoretical foundations for our scheme, and then analyze availability and reasonableness of our proposal from the perspective of the algorithm. This program only needs to activate nodes which are on the maximum probability path to achieve the goal of object detection with minimal number of nodes. That is to say, we form a barrier for intruders in the rectangular area with sensor nodes, and then track the intruder. The advantages of this program are to reduce the number of active nodes and shorten the activation time of nodes so as to improve the lifetime of a wireless sensor network in a large scale.

articleTitle: Research of feedback in psychological testing based on artificial emotion
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: The artificial emotion theory was applied in test and evaluation of the computer psychological test. The subject' emotions (without interest, generally interested, very interested) were defined by analyzing the relative position on the face. The ability of the subjects (upper, middle, lower) was quantified through the issue of classification. The feedback calculation model was then established, and the results were retrieved as a homogeneous cohort emotion for the final credibility calculation. Lots of experiments were performed in FCRS system with this algorithm. The results showed that not only the evaluation results and psychological experts (raters) analysis fully agreed with each other, the improvement of relations between human-computer interactions could also enhance the effects of compute psychological testing.

articleTitle: Time-slot allocation for increasing the energy-efficiency of multi-hop layered WSN
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: Conventional layered network architecture schemes partition sensor nodes into layers based on their distances (i.e., hop-count) from the sink, forwarding gathered data through those nodes with few hop-counts to reduce the energy consumption of a node. Nevertheless, a node that connects with too many nodes in its neighbor layer still incurs significant amount of data forwarding. This node generally exhausts its power supply rapidly, ultimately reducing network lifetime. This work proposes an energy efficient time-slot allocation (EETA) scheme based on the number of neighbor nodes to reduce node energy consumption and prolong network lifetime in a multi-hop layered WSN. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed EETA scheme can prolong network lifetime more than conventional multi-hop layered network architecture schemes.

articleTitle: Multiple gravity-assisted trajectory optimization using a hybrid method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: Global optimization methods have been increasing under consideration for complicated trajectory optimization problems. A hybrid optimization method combining the global optimal properties of genetic algorithms with the local optimal characteristic of sequential quadratic programming has been developed. The genetic algorithm initially searches the parameter space for candidate gravity-assisted planetary. The best parameter of the genetic algorithm is submitted as an initial parameter set to the sequential quadratic programming module for improvement. This hybrid optimization method was applied to optimize and design transfer trajectory of Cassini mission. The effectiveness of this method is demonstrated by the rapid solution of interplanetary trajectory problems that involve complex features such as multiple gravity assist consideration.

articleTitle: Research on seismo-ionospheric anomalies using artificial neural network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: Presently the discovery and research on the disturbances in the ionosphere before earthquake has become increasingly hot research topic. In this paper, the ionospheric occultation data of the COSMIC was used for a detailed study on the ionospheric respond caused by 7.9 magnitude earthquake occurred in Chile on November 14, 2007 and 7.9 magnitude earthquake occurred in Tonga on March 19, 2009. The paper used interpolation techniques of BP neural network, and analyzed the abnormal changes of the F2-layer peak electron density, NmF2 and F2-peak height, hmF2, over the region around the epicenter. The effective experimental results show that NmF2 and hmF2 in ionosphere apparent negative anomaly phenomenon over the region around the epicenter 5 days before the earthquake. The occurrence of these anomalies is most likely from the imminent earthquake.

articleTitle: DV-RSD localization algorithm based on FIND in wireless sensor network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: There exists faulty nodes in wireless sensor networks nodes, the existence of them can effect the localization accuracy, at the same time, traditional DV-HOP algorithm merely use the connectivity information between nodes, thus it may underutilize the proximity information available from neighborhood sensing. According to this, DV-RSD localization algorithm based on FIND is proposed in this paper. First, FIND (Faulty Node Detection for Wireless Sensor Networks) is used to detect the faulty nodes, then removing the faulty nodes from the network. We express the relative distance between neighboring nodes by RSD (Regulated Signature Distance) instead of HOP, the rest stage is the same as in DV-HOP algorithm. Finally, through algorithm analysis, we know that the algorithm is reliable, effective and facile.

articleTitle: Complete 3D model reconstruction using a depth sensor
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: We propose a fast and simple application system of 3D model reconstruction. We acquire range images by using a combination of a regular camera and a depth sensor. The reconstruction of a 3D model consists of four key steps: (i) Initial alignment either feature tracking or the 4-points congruent sets algorithm is used to align surfaces captured at different frames. (ii)The iterative closest point (ICP) method is applied to further align the piecewise surfaces from the last step. (iii) The surfaces are merged into a whole 3D model by the volumetric method. (iv) In the refinement step, we fill holes and produce a complete 3D model that approximates the original model with robust repair of polygonal models. At last, we present the experimental results which show that the errors between our reconstructed model and the ground truth are less than 1%.

articleTitle: Studies on the extracting of image contours based on the principles of insect tendency
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: In this paper, we used simulated insect tendency principle algorithm to obtain the image's color, shape and texture. Used to for based image content retrieval provide the content, we analyze the algorithm with examples and demonstrate the results. The algorithm compared with common order or manual extraction methods in dealing with high-pixel images, has advantages including more speed, outline clearer.

articleTitle: Research on recursive query over XML data stream based on pushdown automation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: For descendant axis (//) and predicate ([]) structural features of XPath with different depths of the XML data stream recursive query processing problem, a method based on pushdown automation is presented. It made the kinds of step transform into the corresponding processing modules, then these modules are combined by the algorithm, the top-down tree query model is built. Because the multi-match will occurred in the query processing, which will produce a large number of matching patterns, the model save and check those matching modules by the effective matching strategy and cache operating, successfully completed the recursive query over XML data stream. Finally, the experimental results show that the proposed method is better than the traditional method.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of vehicular data archive and display based on CAN
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: Aiming at the needs of modern vehicle networking, a data processing system based on CAN bus is designed and implemented. The data processing system implements data exchange with a CAN gateway via UART, which realizes data processing and analysis. By designing system function, the data processing system accomplishes the function of automatic archiving, display of real-time data and archived information. Based on analysis of experimental data, the statistics of data in the system are completely consistent with the archived information of the memory, which can accomplish the task of information display and archive.

articleTitle: Ranking answering in social networks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: Users in social networks can follow and be followed to establish all kinds of cliques. Users' rankings in followed numbers show their popularities, which is an important measurement for social network analysis. In order to give a fast answering for ranking queries, we proposed four methods, ISH, HDD, BBT and SMH. ISH uses inverted sequential hash, HDD is a combination of blocking and hierarchy, BBT utilizes blocking and B- tree technologies, SMH analyzes the sparse of data in large number space, and adapts sequential storage for low values and multi-hashing storage for high values. Our experiments present their different performance in query time and memory consuming.

articleTitle: The research of hierarchical group key management for ad hoc networks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: In the ad hoc networks, group key management is one of the most important secure problems. We propose a hierarchical group key management scheme adapted to large groups according to network characteristics. The scheme put STR hierarchical tree structure into distributed sub-group management model effectively, and combine layer-based key management with cycle-based key management, in order to reduce the communication and computation cost greatly, and is of good attribute in expansibility and lange ad hoc networks.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Based on embedded serial device remote monitoring system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: The survival probability in generalized compound poisson risk model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: In this paper we discuss the survival probabilities in the limited time when the individual claim amount obeys the gamma distribution and exponential distribution. At the same time for the classical compound Poisson model we also give a more precise expression about the survival probability in the limited time. We obtain some extend results and give some applications in vehicle damage insurance.

articleTitle: Improve spectrum efficiency based on variable-power AMC and ARQ for OFDM systems
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: To improve spectrum efficiency (SE), the adaptive modulation and coding (AMC) and automatic repeat request (ARQ) scheme have been combined for OFDM systems. In this paper, we add variable power subject to power constraint in each AMC mode. We use KKT optimization algorithm to get the optimal transmit power and AMC mode boundaries. The numerical results show that the average SE is increased by about 0.3 bits/sec/Hz for OFDM systems with Nakagami fading with parameter m=2 when SNR is around 15dB and the retransmission is once.

articleTitle: Comparative research on Python speed optimization strategies
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: Python script language offers high development efficiency, abundant and versatile libraries; as a result nowadays it is used in a wide range of research projects and products domains. However, Python's interpretation characteristic becomes a speed bottleneck in some case, especially for extensive numerical operations. To solve this problem, many technologies to optimize Python are proposed. In this paper, we summarize the existing technologies and catalog them into 3 classes. The principles of respective technologies are explained. Experiments on representative Python codes are carried out, and then the speed performance, advantages and disadvantages are compared and explained in details. The experiment results reveal that Python codes can speed up by using feasible algorithm, or caching policies without resort to any external tools. Tools, such as Shed-skin and psyco, can enhance the speed performance with the minimal modification on original Python code models. Using extension libraries in static languages has a great advantage over other methods in the efficiency, which can supply a very higher speed raise. Thus in a particular situation, in order to get a desirable performance, the user should choose and resort to applicable technology according to the requirements.

articleTitle: Sliding mode control of a hyper-chaos system with only one nonlinear term
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: A four-dimensional dynamic system with only one nonlinear term was constructed and analysed the chaotic complex dynamic characteristics, including the space trajectory, the Lyapunov exponent and the Poincare map. These characteristics enable us to know deeply them, and indicate that the four-dimensional dynamical system contains hyper-chaotic attractor. For overcoming the shortcomings that the system can never be controlled to target orbit precisely in feedback control theory, the chaotic orbits were stabilized to arbitrary chosen any fixed points and any periodic orbits by means of sliding mode method, and MATLAB Simulations were presented to confirm the validity of the controller. The results show that using sliding mode method can make the system track target orbit smoothly with short transition time.

articleTitle: Study on intelligent control of road condition perception and forward collision warning system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: This paper describes a road condition perception and forward collision warning system (PWS). It enhances the capability of road condition perception, and improves the drive-safety. Firstly the research background, development of intelligent vehicle and road condition perception technology are introduced. Then the structure of PWS is proposed. It consists of three levels: road condition perception level, decision-making level and execution level. The three sub-systems of PWS, central control module, forward collision warning (FCW) system and adaptive front-lighting System (AFS), are researched respectively. According to the proposed structure, PWS experimental platform is built. Some road test has been performed on this platform, and the result indicates that PWS is effective to give collision warning and enhance vehicle illumination.

articleTitle: Planning for SOC test with power constraint based on quantum algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: Combining with the characteristic of SOC test planning and test power, the optimization for SOC test based on quantum algorithm is introduced in this paper, in the paper, the corresponding mathematical model is established and the design of algorithm is given. After establishing the model with appropriate parameters, the power limit is ascertained, then the optimal individual can be distinguished. During the process of algorithm realization, genetic factors are changed according to a discriminant function, and the shortest test times with power constraints can be find out. Validation of the algorithm is made with ITC'02 SOC test benchmarks finally. Experimental results demonstrate the advantages of quantum algorithm compared with other algorithms.

articleTitle: Formalizing the multiple abstraction process within the G-KRA model framework
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: Many researchers have explored the abstraction theory and tried to capture the essence of abstraction. In this paper, we propose the concept of Flow Fragment (FF) and apply FF to the G-KRA model framework. The FF-based model can be automatically constructed by recognizing the flow fragments of the abstraction model which is generated during the abstraction modeling phase in the G-KRA model. The mapping from a flow fragment FF to the constructed abstraction model is defined to realize the sharing of abstract objects. We also discuss capturing the effect-based model using the constituent PHObjects of FFs. Moreover, the FF Database is created and extended by aggregation operation on the constructed FFs to realize FF reuse for the tasks of automatic abstraction.

articleTitle: Stability by feedback of the second order singular distributed parameter systems containing finite many poles with multi-observers
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: Stability by feedback of the second order singular distributed parameter system containing finite many poles with multi-observers is discussed via functional analysis and operator theory in Hilbert space, the conditions of the problem existing solutions and the constructive expression of the solutions are given by the singular inverse one of bounded linear operator. This research is theoretically important for studying the stability of the singular distributed parameter systems.

Author Keywords: second order singular distributed parameter system

articleTitle: Study on design for outsourcing using evidence theory decision tree
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: One of the most popular strategies in business today is global outsourcing, where maintenance as a non-core process is often outsourced. Outsourced maintenance information can affect the product development sustainability, achievement transformation capacity and product quality. Data generated in the processes of outsourced maintenance are inherently uncertain and seldom classified according to their importance. From these data the relevant uncertain information can be able to search. Since evidence theory is a powerful tool can deal with uncertain data, this paper propose a search mechanism use evidence theory decision tree algorithm to classify uncertain data generated form outsourced maintenance and to dig out the rules. The experimental results shows this algorithm can efficient classify uncertain data and generate rules which can guide the products research and development.

articleTitle: The design of intelligent marking system for electronic circuit experiment reports
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: Aimed at the multi-disciplinary teaching of electronic circuit experiment for school students, an intelligent marking system for electronic circuit experiment reports is developed. The structure and implementation of the system framework are described. The students can upload experiment data to the teacher'PC by wireless sense method in this system, generating test reports and marking them automatically. The students can upload the experiment data in the class, and download them after school.

articleTitle: The research and implementation of annual charging system based on directory tree algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: Aiming at the defect of charging list mode of traditional annual charging system, this paper fully studied the characteristic of the algorithm based on directory tree. Combined father-son recursive algorithm with the database, the dynamically generated charging tree could be generated accurately and efficiently, the annual charging system could be also implemented. The application result shown that the method had the characteristic of more definite objective and the humanization, and could efficiently improve the work efficiency and the ability of the system service.

articleTitle: Research and application of metadata in information management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: Being aimed against to the software reusability and interoperability, we design a metadata-driven information management system. when developing a new application, we can search quickly, locate, and reconstruct on existing IT resources by meta-data description, discovery, mapping and conversion. In the three-tier architecture based on the SSH, we implement B/S model of information management systems by means of entity metadata description and deployment, data Access Services. Experimental results show the design is effective and feasible.

articleTitle: Analysis of erhu playing by novice player - First step to skill learning environment for erhu playing -
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: Goal of this paper is to analyze novices' erhu playing. Erhu is a two-stringed instrument created in China. Hair of stick is located between two strings. Therefore the stick motion is much different from other string instruments such as violin. Firstly, we analyzed erhu playing and clarified parameters to generate noises. Then, we analyzed novices' finger pressures during erhu playing. To achieve this task, we recorded erhu playing by video camera, and measured finger pressures on strings when players are playing erhu. The purpose of the analysis is to examine what kind of errors novice players have, and we will take it into account when we design the learning environment.

articleTitle: Run-time environment construction approach for virtualized simulation system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: High performance computer simulation system plays an increasingly important role in exploration of complex science and engineering problems in the real world. A significant challenge is that the complexity of underlying resources always makes it difficult to rapidly construct a simulation application and rapidly deploy a run-time environment for users' tasks especially in the case of complex simulation applications. Virtualization technology provides a promising approach to solve this problem. This paper presents a run-time environment construction approach for virtualized simulation system. The paper first presents a model for high performance simulation system on virtualization. Then the paper describes the deployment approach to leveraging virtualized simulation resources to establish run-time simulation environment. The virtualization method can develop an effective approach for rapid and convenient deployment of simulation resources for complex simulation systems through dynamic distribution of customized virtual machine templates.

articleTitle: The parameters fitness of SWCC considering consolidation stress by GA
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: Soil-Water Characteristic Curve (SWCC) is one of the most important parameters of unsaturated soils. It plays an important role in theoretical research and practical application. For the convenience of practical application, some models are presented, such as Gardner model, V-G model, etc. Recent experimental results show that besides water content, the consolidation stress has influence on SWCC either, while most of the models did not consider this factor. In this paper, based on the experimental results of SWCC under different consolidation stresses, GA is chosen to fit the parameters of a specific curve which is developed from exponential attenuation function. With the definition of the parameters, a SWCC model which considering different consolidation stresses is put forward. The fitness results compared with previous research according to experimental results shows higher accuracy.

articleTitle: Near infrared face recognition based on wavelet transform and 2DPCA
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: A feature extraction algorithm of near-infrared human face based on wavelet transform and 2DPCA (two-dimension principal component analysis) was proposed. This algorithm firstly applied wavelet transform to the near-infrared face images, obtained the low frequency components of face images, and removed high frequency components. Secondly applied 2DPCA to the low frequency components of the face images for feature extraction. Finally completed the face recognition using Euclidean distance. The experimental results based on near-infrared face database clearly showed that the proposed algorithm could get higher recognition rate than the traditional PCA and 2DPCA algorithm, which demonstrated the efficiency of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Tensor voting based method for image denoising
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: The computation of voting field is the key computation step of image de-noising based on tensor voting that is a highly robust feature extraction method. As the traditional tensor voting field is approximately elliptic and symmetry, there will be redundant computation resulted during the course of tensor voting superposition. The voting field of the images of symmetry property can be simplified to half of the original traditional field. On the basis of this simplification idea, this paper presents an image de-noising method based on voting field, with a comparison of its result with those of median filter de-noising and of wavelet de-noising. The experiment shows that the method presented in this paper can efficiently reduce the image noise, with the key details of the image preserved.

articleTitle: Variable weights in MADM
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: Dealing with multi-attribute decision making (MADM) problems, the comprehensive weighted model is a simple tool. But how to determine weights is a critical problem in this method. In this paper, beginning with a discussion of the term “weight”, we discuss present variable weighting methods. Then we propose an idea of denoting weights by a fuzzy set as well as a corresponding weight aggregate model. Finally, we prove the effectiveness of the model by a numerical experiment.

articleTitle: A trust rating classification model in P2P resource discovery
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: This paper begins with an analysis of the defects of low efficiency and weak security of P2P network in the resource discovery, followed by the design of a trust rating classification model of vertically hierarchical structure and horizontal sub-domain. On the basis of the model that the all the nodes are divided into different layers vertically and different sub-domains horizontally, a classification algorithm of resource creditability is presented. The simulation experiment shows that this algorithm improves the efficiency and precision and enhances the security in P2P resource discovery.

articleTitle: The research of tile declustering in high-performance heterogeneous disk systems
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: The necessity of applying data declustering in Terrain Server System is discussed and two-dimensional declustering for tile-matrix of terrain data is defined. After studying the questions of data allocation and tile declustering in heterogeneous disk systems, a same-rate virtual disk dividing method and a virtual disk sorting method are proposed. The method transform the heterogeneous disk systems to same-rate virtual disk systems in order to ensure current data declustering method available for heterogeneous disk systems. Experimental results of response time and rate show that this method can manage massive terrain data and provide high data streams.

articleTitle: MCM interconnect test project using ant colony algorithm with crossover operator
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: A novel multi-chip module (MCM) interconnect test generation project using ant colony algorithm (ACA) with crossover operator is presented in this paper. By combing the characteristics of MCM interconnect test generation, the pheromone updating rule and state transition rule of ACA is designed. By using crossover operator in this project, ordinary ACA's defects of slow convergence speed, easy to get stagnate, and low ability of full search can be improved. The international standard MCM benchmark circuit provided by the MCNC group was used to validate the approach. Simulation results, which compare to the results of standard ACA, genetic algorithm (GA) and other deterministic interconnecting algorithms, show that the proposed project can achieve high fault coverage, compact test set and short CPU time.

articleTitle: A method of spatial clustering based on the combination of the spatial coordinate and attributes
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: Combining coordinate with attributes, we can define three Manhattan spatial distance measurements. And ACA-Cluster based on one of the definitions is realized by Matlab7.0 programming. In this way, the result can avoid the objects of the same cluster appearing on non-adjacent spatial positions, meanwhile, reflect the spatial distribution. So the cities of Shandong Province are clustered effectively and objectively according to eco-environment index.

articleTitle: Uniqueness of positive solutions for singular Sturm-Liouville like nonlocal boundary value problems
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: We consider the existence and uniqueness of positive solutions for a class of fourth-order singular Sturm-Liouville like nonlocal boundary value problems. The main result is obtained by means of mixed monotone method.

articleTitle: Design and implement of a remote monitoring system of battery
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: According to the difficulty of the maintenance of the battery, a monitoring system of batteries on-line is developped. The voltage, temperature and internal resistance in each unit of the battery are digitized in order to realize the real time on-line measurement and find timely the failure batteries. A monitoring sensor of batteries and data concentrators is designed. The design principle of the battery monitoring is analysed. The overall structure of system is provided. The design of the system is introduced in detailed. Comparing with the centralized monitoring system which use the analog signal isolation, this design has better precision and reliability, safety and stability, low cost and small volume, and has good prospect of engineering application.

articleTitle: Optimal cooperative spectrum sensing for cognitive radio
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: Several factors like fading and shadow affect the ability of weak signal detection. Previous work has shown that cooperation among the cognitive users can increase the detection probability for a given probability of false alarm. The paper is to develop a spectrum sensing scheme for cognitive radio based on a model that is realistic and takes into account all the factors that would affect the system. It investigates the effect of variable channel gain on the cooperation between secondary users, proposes a cooperative spectrum sensing scheme. The results of the simulation, done based on the analytical results, are then presented which show the extent of advantage cooperation between the secondary radios and the effect of the channel gain between the secondary user and the fusion centre.

articleTitle: Based on Multi-Agent 3-layer data cleaning system model design
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: For some inefficiencies and non-intelligence in the traditional model of data cleaning, this paper designs a 3-layer data cleaning system model based on Multi-Agent, and discusses the running process of this model. The model compensates the limitation and deficiencies; moreover, to a great extent it improves the capabilities of intelligence and efficiency, and reduces the participation by people.

articleTitle: Application of reversible watermarking to video hard authentication
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: This paper presents a fragile, blind and erasable watermark with low video quality degradations, the watermarking is done after the H.264 compression process. The framework computes a watermark, embeds the watermark and generates a new H.264 bit stream. The payload of the watermark consists of the encrypted hash value and a certificate with the public key. Some skipped macroblocks of the H.264 video are used to embed the watermark. The result of the framework is a new watermarked H.264 bit stream.

articleTitle: Research and implementation Of the temperature control system of heat treatment based on .NET and RS-485 bus
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: RS-485 is a widely used industrial field bus. The successful application of AIBUS protocol in AI series display control instrument, make the AIDCS system's cost significantly lower than traditional DCS system. The paper successfully developed a prototype system based on RS-485 bus for high precision temperature control system of heat treatment, and based on the .net and AIBUS protocol, developed it' s system management software. This system have the characteristics of good real-time, high control-precision, high degree of automation, and friendly human-machine interface.

articleTitle: Operating speed prediction model and systems of highway based on space compound curvature
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: Based on the analysis of operation safety data of expressway and the investigation on the spot, the influence of the horizontal, vertical, cross-sectional alignment index on safety were studied. The vehicles track was seemed as the three-dimensional curve. According to the road alignment space geometric properties, the compound curvature of the horizontal and vertical curve combination alignment of expressway was calculated and modified by gradient. Then the relationship between the alignment evaluation index and the operating speed was analyzed. Considering the influence of cross-sectional alignment, the operating speed prediction model of expressway based on compound curvature was established. The prediction model was proved of high reliability through the contrast between field data and model calculated data. A case study was given to explain the application of the research result of this project. At last, the paper compiled the highway operating speed prediction system software (OSPS).

articleTitle: Degradation models of inertial platform based on the possibility distribution
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Integrated Systems
abstract: The present existing approach to the general degradation measure distribution model to deal with measurement errors is lesser. The article did the weight disposal in light of the possibility distribution of measurement data. And the complicacy of the inertial platform is analyzed. Then a multiple degradation model for the platform is presented, based on the possibility distribution of performance degradation measure. The analysis proved that the improved degradation measure distribution model can reduce the influence of measurement error and advance the analysis accuracy. It also showed that the constructed multiple degradation model can compute its life-span distribution effectively.
